title: State-conditioned direct-greedy mirrored ES smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: A frozen Standard10 plus a 585-parameter state-conditioned random-feature residual output can obtain a reproducible direct-greedy improvement signal with mirrored common-random-number ES, producing positive gen0-to-gen2 untouched broad-holdout slope in both seats while preserving at least 95% of Standard10 greedy actions.
material_change: Replace sampled-policy/critic gradient credit with two generations of mirrored parameter-space ES over only the residual policy output layer. Use eight antithetic directions per generation, six heterogeneous training opponents, both seats, fresh generation-specific common decks, robust mean-minus-dispersion fitness, three SHA-disjoint untouched holdouts, a residual logit cap, and fixed center-L2 trust region. No Slumbot or benchmark-specific rules.
baseline: Standard10 is the only reproducible external frontier parent. PPO/MGDA/CAGrad gradient variants either transferred negatively or lacked multi-seed breadth; a prior 18-dimensional global bias search overfit. This treatment is state-conditioned and directly optimizes the deployed greedy contract.
notes: Method rationale: Salimans et al., Evolution Strategies as a Scalable Alternative to Reinforcement Learning, arXiv:1703.03864. Promotion requires positive split-half direction correlation in both generations, positive untouched validation slopes, two-of-three holdout breadth, both seats, and Standard10 preservation; a small-budget non-win alone is not interpreted as universal algorithm rejection.

result.summary: The direct-greedy mirrored ES smoke completed exactly 12,288 broad training environment hands and 4,608 untouched validation games, but sigma 0.005 never crossed a greedy action boundary: all 16 antithetic fitness differences were exactly zero, both generation updates had L2 zero, the center stayed bit-exact at zero residual, and every validation delta was zero. All 262 tests passed.
result.conclusion: This is a perturbation-dose contract failure, not negative policy-strength evidence. The frozen Standard10 parent and residual remained behaviorally identical with 100% preservation, so the run did not test whether activated state-conditioned ES can learn. The zero signal reproduced on two fresh generation-specific deck cohorts, making further hands at sigma 0.005 wasteful.
result.next_step: Run an outcome-blind state-panel sigma calibration over the exact random-feature output parameterization, targeting a small but nonzero 1-5% greedy disagreement rate while respecting the 0.25 residual cap. Then repeat only the minimum mirrored cohort at the calibrated dose and require split-half signal reproducibility before any geometric scale.
